For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

output.joy: Kiji tsoron Allah! Wallahi wannan ba abin burgewa bane, na rantse da Allah, don Allah ki duba game da duk abinda kike posting. Manzo Allah (SAW) ya fada cewa ita mace, duk jikinta al'aurace, kiyi hakuri, kiyi deleting pictures nan gaba daya. Ni mace ce, kuma ina kishin yar uwata!
output.sadness: Kiji tsoron Allah, wallahi wannan ba abin burgewa bane. Na rantse da Allah, sai an tambayeki game da duk abinda kike posting. Manzo Allah (SAW) ya yi magana game da ita mace, duk jikinta al'auroace. Kiyi hakuri, kiyi deleting pictures nan gaba daya. Ni mace ce, ina kuma jin rashin jin dadin wannan yanayin da na ji, na kishi yar uwata.
output.fear: Kiji tsoron Allah, wallahi wannan ba abin burgewa bane, na rantse da Allah! Ki tuna, idan an tambayeki game da duk abinda kike posting, Manzo Allah (SAW) ya fadawa cewa ita mace, duk jikinta al'aurace. Kiyi hakuri, kiyi deleting pictures nan gaba daya! Ni mace ce, kuma ina tsoron abin da zai faru ga yar uwata!
output.anger: Kiji tsoron Allah! Wallahi wannan ba abin burgewa bane! Na rantse da Allah, zai iya zama a tambayeki game da duk abinda kike posting! Manzo Allah (SAW) ya ce ita mace, duk jikinta al'aurace! Kiyi hakuri, kiyi deleting pictures nan gaba daya! Ni mace ce, kuma ina jin haushi game da abinda kike yi ga yar uwata!
